title: Barnstormer

Despite his mother's and grandmother's concerns about the dangers of space, Pete yearns for adventure and dreams of becoming a spaceman. As he tries to navigate the restrictions imposed by his family, the story highlights his determination to experience the thrill of flying and to embrace a future filled with possibilities.
